vol.name: Star Trek: Red Shirts--Ghost of the 21st Century

title: Star Trek: Red Shirts--Ghost of the 21st Century #4
desc:
Lyna Taval and Harry Deubert infiltrate Captain Miller's ship, the Baychimo, for glorious battle—on Lyna's part, if not Deubert's.

There, they'll finally have the chance to confront Miller and his nefarious organization, Section Null, once and for all. Starfleet will be free from his influence once more, able to move on as the force for good it was meant to be without a splinter at its heart.

But Miller is waiting, ready to tighten the garrote around the throats of the agents looking to take him down. Lyna and Deubert are welcome to underestimate him…at their peril.
